rule: Claude never runs ffmpeg/yt-dlp/whisper/rclone/curl/remotion; scripts do
No deleting from Claude's shell; only approved scrap via Drive trash
Secrets never go into commands or files
Big files go to Drive by script, never into chat
Every rule, lesson and memory file stays under 60 lines
Look before sending, reference record, sample first; worker refuses plans without them
Colour grade is automatic unless Faiz turns it off
Every job step writes a cost row; a missing row halts the system
A FAILED job halts new work until the lesson is fed (./run learn)
Write/Edit outside the task's scope paths is blocked while a scope is set
Once Faiz approved something, never ask for it again
Every number in replies to Faiz is written in words
Answer Faiz's question first, then start work
Every wait gets a reminder sized to the task
Free tools by default; paid or trials only on his command
every hard rule is in config/rules.json with an enforcer; no cost row or no lesson after a FAILED job = HALT
Plan is BLOCKED unless beats table is approved (sha) and unchanged
Director plan needs gates verdict DELIVER; BLOCK is fixed in the plan, never by lowering a gate
Reference style is measured numbers (30 fps profile); unmeasured parts are reported, never guessed
Same review complaint twice is promoted to a rule + lesson
Free services change (HF 410, Pollinations 402, Sarvam v2 gone, Kaggle queue): never plan a run on a service without a live test the same day
scripts/smoke.py runs before every runner-side long job; fail stops it
A free engine failing mid-run hands over to the next free engine on its own; the report names who spoke
A failed job behind a pipe must show red, never a green tick
use ./run ci <workflow> --wait N (waits inside the script, prints one line); no repeated gh/timer polling, delete unused timers
enforcer: C: ./run ci exists and is tested (tests/test_ci_brief.py)

rule: ./run tools before any build; say why an owned tool is skipped; zoom on stills is never called 3D motion graphics
enforcer: C: ./run tools exists and is in CLAUDE.md step 0c (tests/test_inventory.py)

rule: ./run gate-check voice <script.txt> --seconds N blocks above 165 wpm
stills_api raises on a cut prompt; style_card.shot_prompt writes subject-first prompts that fit
./run gate-check looked <job> --score N after Checker looked; below 7 of 10 = not delivered; motion claim check
./run gate-check waiting|approved <key>; mem brief prints WAITING/STALLED and ALREADY APPROVED
config/style-cards/<creator>.json = style rules; new topics built from the card via style_card.shot_prompt, reference copy only when Faiz says clone
./run gate-check shots <shotbook.json> blocks any shot missing subject/detail/material/light/lens/camera/fx/caption or repeating another; shotbook.micro_prompt writes the prompt
./run gate-check script <file> --seconds N compares with the creator's measured profile; every number needs a source in facts
pixel parts are canvas-drawn per frame, no Img/staticFile (test_eightbit); remotion.media blocks local render here, so sample look-check runs on worker
